log.msg: MEASURED — hovered leaf's bar 15 controls (4 on the strip, 11 behind more_horiz, most opening a popover) -> 6 (handle, split-cols, split-rows, tune, magnifier, close). Clipped popovers on /framework/ext/Panel/: 365 at 1280 and 343 at 400 -> 0 and 0.

BUG, pre-existing, fixed in fence: ext/layout/panel.js wires $rail.on('click', refresh) once and never unwires, so the FIRST click on any Panel rail control handed the whole rail to ext/layout ('nothing selected'). A plain tone button did it as surely as a dropdown. Fixed by claiming the click on .panel-props-row; the real fix is an ownership test in ext/layout (proposal below).

BUG, pre-existing, fixed in fence: the DRAWER rail never re-rendered. properties() has a change listener; fields() drawn by tools.js has none, so every control rendered its lit state once - pick cells and the trigger still said toc, pick grid and the grid rows never appeared. That is the owner's 'the dropdown doesn't do anything'. apply() now repaints the panel and restates the rail by re-announcing panel-focus, keeping the rail's scroll.

BUG, pre-existing, fixed in fence: paint.js's views map holds ONE entry per item, and /framework/ext/Panel/ draws 16 workspaces - repaint(target) redrew a copy in another workspace while the ring sat on the one you clicked ('works on refresh, but not on dropdown -> select'). apply() now paints the focused body when views disagrees with it. One-view-per-item is paint.js's to fix.

PROPOSAL (ext/layout is out of this task's fence). ext/layout/panel.js:69 - refresh() must return when the rail is not ext/layout's: add `if (!document.querySelector('.drawer .layout-sect, .drawer .layout-empty')) return;` as its first line, or unwire on takeover. Without it every module sharing ext/drawer loses the rail on its own first click.

PROPOSAL: paint.js's `views` should hold a SET of renderings per item (or repaint() should walk every .panel matching the item's id), so a page drawing one root twice repaints both. properties.js paints the focused body by hand today, which is a plaster.

assign.outcome:
**The bar is six controls and nothing on it opens** — every word moved to the rail, and no popover in the module can be clipped any more.

![](bar-after.png)

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| controls on a hovered leaf's bar | **15** (4 on the strip, 11 behind `more_horiz`, most opening a picker) | **6** — drag · split-cols · split-rows · `tune` · magnifier · close |
| clipped popovers, `/framework/ext/Panel/` | **365** at 1280 · **343** at 400 | **0** · **0** |

**[ext/Dropdown](/framework/ext/Dropdown/)** (new, 100 lines) — a trigger showing the value's picture *and* name, and a list in the browser's **top layer**, so no `overflow: hidden` can cut it. `popover="auto"` brings outside-click and Escape for free. Two callers: the rail's `template` (29 entries) and `display`. [decisions](/framework/ext/Dropdown/doc/decisions/) · [readme](/framework/ext/Dropdown/readme.md)

![](dropdown.png)

**The rail is the UI** — [`/framework/ext/Panel/`](/framework/ext/Panel/), click a panel or press `tune`. `wrap` is one lit button, not a `nowrap | wrap` pair (`toggle: true`); so are `dense` and a split's `group`. `tone` is 1×4 and `width`/`height` are one line each.

![](rail.png)

**Three bugs the sweep uncovered — all pre-existing, all in the rail, all fixed.** [doc/focus.md](/framework/ext/Panel/doc/focus/)
1. The **first click on any rail control handed the rail to `ext/layout`** (it wires one listener on the shared drawer and never unwires). A plain `tone` button did it as surely as a dropdown.
2. The drawer rail **never redrew itself** — pick `cells` and the trigger still said `toc`; pick `grid` and the grid rows never appeared. The owner's *"the dropdown doesn't do anything."*
3. `repaint()` **redrew a copy in another workspace** while the ring sat on the one you clicked — the owner's *"works on refresh, but not on dropdown → select."*

**Proved headless** (socket blocked): pick `cells` → 12 cells + the repeat tile in the panel you clicked, trigger relabelled, rail intact; `display` → grid via one control; `wrap` toggles `flex-wrap` on/off; list whole inside the viewport at 1280 **and** 400; zero console errors on 14 pages.

**Left deliberately.** The live duplicate lost its only button (alt-drop still makes one). Two proposals in this log need the owner: `ext/layout/panel.js` must not claim a rail that is not its own, and `paint.js`'s `views` should hold every rendering of an item, not the last one — `properties.js` paints the focused body by hand today, which is a plaster.
